title: Upgrading Zero Trust Branch Appliances in Standalone Deployments

blocks.text: Zero Trust Branch upgrades standalone appliances through an in-place software update. The appliance briefly goes offline while the new version is installed and the system restarts.
To upgrade Zero Trust Branch appliances running in standalone mode:

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Zero Trust Branch > Deployments > Sites.
The Sites page appears.
Locate the site for which you want to upgrade the Zero Trust Branch appliance, and use one of the following options:
Click the Download icon next to the version number.
See image.
Click the Gear icon and select Upgrade Appliance Version.
See image.
The Appliance Version Manager drawer appears.
In the Appliance Version Manager drawer, upgrade the appliance using one of the following methods:
Standard method
Available Versions: Select the version to which you want the Zero Trust Branch appliance to be upgraded from the drop-down menu.
See image.
Click Upgrade.
Root FS method

The Root FS upgrade method allows you to download up to three image versions of the Zero Trust Branch appliance software, and you can install one of these versions based on your requirements. You can also designate one version as a default version, which allows Zero Trust Branch to apply the image automatically during a factory reset.
This upgrade method is currently in Preview.
Only Zero Trust Branch appliances with versions 8.0.6 or later are supported.
Enable Use Root FS Upgrade Method.
Downloadable Versions: Select the version image that must be downloaded to the Zero Trust Branch appliance.
Click Download.
See image.
The selected version image is downloaded to the Zero Trust Branch appliance and the status displays in the Downloaded Versions table.

Beginning with version 8.0.6 and later, the image size was optimized to allow downloading and storing up to three images on the appliance. If your appliance includes older images (e.g., 8.0.4 HF1), the downloading and installation of the third image might fail due to space constraints. To avoid this issue, you can delete one of the older images.
After the download is complete, select the corresponding entry in the Downloaded Versions table and click Activate.
See image.
The selected version is installed on the Zero Trust Branch appliance and the status displays in the Downloaded Versions table.
Select the image and click Set as Default.

During the upgrade process, the Zero Trust Branch appliance transitions through multiple stages indicated by the upgrade status. After completing the upgrade process, the Zero Trust Branch appliance automatically transitions to the Active state.
Upgrade statuses
The following table provides the list of upgrade statuses:

table: The Zero Trust Branch appliance software version is being downloaded.
The downloaded version is being applied to the Zero Trust Branch appliance.
The Zero Trust Branch appliance is rebooting after the update.
The Zero Trust Branch appliance is initializing with the new software version.
The Zero Trust Branch appliance is running the necessary scripts, utilities, and containers.
The update is completed and the Zero Trust Branch appliance has resumed normal operation.
